name: The Damned

meta.next: Marla's Last Wish, Scavenging Deathknell, Night Web's Hollow (Classic); A Light in the Darkness (Forever) ( only)

summary: New Forsaken in Deathknell turn to Novice Elreth for clothing and battlefield wraps. She trades salvaged armor for the materials needed to make them.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Trade
sections.body: Novice Elreth tends the newly risen Forsaken in Deathknell. She assists Shadow Priest Sarvis, cares for battered soldiers, and mends their garments. Supplies run short, so she sends you into the surrounding glades to hunt duskbats and scavenger wolves. Their pelts, wings, and sinew help keep the camp supplied, and Elreth offers salvaged armor in return.

sections.title: Inherited Protection
sections.body: Elreth's armor has already belonged to Forsaken who did not survive their awakening. She hopes it serves you better than its previous owner. In Tirisfal Glades, every piece of leather and rusted chain is put to use.

faq.answer: Novice Elreth is an acolyte in Deathknell's chapel and an aide to Shadow Priest Sarvis. She tends wounded Forsaken, mends garments, and equips new arrivals.

faq.q: Why does Elreth need scavenger paws and duskbat wings?
faq.answer: Elreth needs scavenger paws and duskbat wings to gather materials for repairs and wraps. Deathknell has little to spare, so she turns to the wildlife in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where did the armor reward come from?
faq.answer: The armor came from Forsaken who did not survive their awakening. Elreth salvages usable gear to protect new arrivals.
Young Scavengers and Duskbats live just south of Deathknell. Tougher ones roam east toward the Scarlet Crusade outpost.

faq.q: How does this task fit into the defence of Deathknell?
faq.answer: Elreth helps prepare newly risen Forsaken to face nearby threats, including mindless undead and the Scarlet Crusade. Shadow Priest Sarvis expects them to be ready for danger.

faq.q: What happens after helping Novice Elreth?
faq.answer: After helping Elreth, you can take on other work around Deathknell: honoring Marla's last wish, dealing with the spiders at Night Web's Hollow, and recovering supplies across the settlement.

angles.text: For a fresh Forsaken, this shows the hard practicality of survival: fallen predecessors leave gear behind, and the blighted land provides what else is needed.
As a tailor, you see how Forsaken make do in Lordaeron, using wing membranes and scavenged pelts where clean cloth is scarce.
